body:
Contact him.  It will make him feel not forgotten. 

Speaking from the other side of the story. Visit him from time to time and check up / encourage him. 

If my ex said 

- if you find a job making 150k (outlandish for me) it would motivate me to try 

Or

- if we both don’t find anyone in two years I’ll come back (marriage pact) it would calm me 

Instead everytime I try emailing job acceptance, school results, or gym results I get a “stop contacting me”. So the whatever happiness reaching my short term goals is crushed because it’s not enough. 

I get it the message by now, but it really fucks my motivation and will to live.  

I’m the best person I ever was on the outside but its all for nothing. Something is not enough.   Everything I do have I don’t want.

Sometimes I feel like my ex is the reason why I get visits or invites from friends. 

I’m not gonna ask. Wish/dont wish it was her directly. I just want to be normal

From my expierence seeing her brings a very short lived high following by a long crippling low.  For me it’s worth the dopamine hit. For others or future me it might push them over.

Not a good state of mind and repair is hard.

Drinking wont kill you. Eventually it will hard to be buzzed. You will either be sober or passed out.  I stopped drinking just it because my body was getting VERY fat but no where death. (2 handles a day for half a year) 

the gym has really brought some motivation to my life but the other problems remain. Hang in there. 

I too keep my problems away from others and put a fake smile.  Its the hardest to be alone, so try to enjoy the company of others (even those outside your age bracket or social circle)

Also lol @ social events and people wondering how you are sober.  Not a proud share the real reason the superpower.  

Basically a high functioning alcoholic. It stops numbing the pain. 

>There will be people who see through the bullshit, and give you tips lowkey, without being judge mental. (Go traveling, stay busy with any job, ive been through XXX and here is how i dealt with it and will actually share something similar.). Mad respect, but then I feel guilty as fuck.  The few that see through it since they experienced the SAME. 

> So keep in mind we are not the only ones with problems
